formattedAddress: 110, Taiwan, Taipei City, Xinyi District, 信義區 Songren Rd, 58號14樓

text.text:
Need to have reservations to go to this restaurant especially on holiday.  Luckily I go here weekdays and reserve a sit for 1 person on the day and it has vacant. This is not a fine dining experience and expect loud atmosphere especially some costumer already drunk. They have quick activities for fun like hollahoop show. I like also how the girls waitress serve and entertain you as foreigners.  They can speak English and I don't feel discriminated here.

I ate alone with a good food and ambiance.  I reserve 22:00 and I got early in taipei so I move 21:30 in my reservations and have vacant seat for me.

text.text: We had fun, and it’s a birthday blowout from our September babies friends. We love the ambiance since it is famous already as you can take pictures with taipei 101 from the hooters building. The foods I love is the white Pasta with mushroom, the chickens, not too with the baby back ribs since its dry and no sauce. But overall, the food is good, the view is nice, and entertainment is great. We were thankful that the rain falls heavy when we already got there anyways.

text.text: Fun American sports-bar vibe with a lively atmosphere right in Xinyi District. The menu has classic Hooters favourites — wings, burgers, pasta, salads and more — and people like coming for the cold drinks, tasty food, and great views of Taipei 101 from the outdoor terrace at night. The service is friendly and it’s a good spot for casual hangouts or group dinners.

text.text: Ordered pasta and pizza and it was great, was not a big fan of the fruit beverage I ordered. I politely asked if the server could take a photo of us with the Taipei 101, but she said she’ll get back since she was really busy. Hooters Xinyi Branch could really get busy and jampacked when its near dinner time plus it was a weekend. We made an advance reservation for a 4:30 pm timeslot via their website. Eventually she came back and have taken a photo of us, I really appreciate her time and effort to do so. Regarding the reserved tables we booked, it was really chilly outside and other customers are smoking. They accept credit cards. We left even before our time limit with enough memories of Taipei 101 to get by.

text.text:
The wings are outstanding. I don’t normally go for wings but I heard about them so had to try and I was not disappointed.

I opted for the boneless and they were so juicy and big! The sauces went well, curry garlic, cheese and bbq. Thinking about it makes me want to go back.

The atmosphere was fun and the punters were friendly and talkative. The staff also tentative and spoke English well. It was an all round good time and the views are pretty nice too, with 101 right there.
